milestones.title: First commit
milestones.text: Paperbase starts: a shop builder for sellers in Bangladesh who sell on cash on delivery.

milestones.title: Five shop servers become one
milestones.text: Every merchant moves onto a single platform, each shop still on its own domain. A fix now ships once and reaches every shop.

milestones.title: An honest audit
milestones.text: A full audit logs 118 problems. One of them: a 12-item order took 521 database queries. The critical ones get fixed.

milestones.title: Ads that count the right sale
milestones.text: Each shop chooses when its ads count a sale: when the order is placed, or only once the seller confirms it.

milestones.title: A fraud check before shipping
milestones.text: Before a parcel goes out, the seller sees the buyer’s delivery record across couriers: delivered, cancelled, success rate.

milestones.title: A status page that stays up
milestones.text: Written in Rust and run on its own server, so it stays up even when the platform doesn’t.

milestones.title: Secure on every shop’s own domain
milestones.text: Every shop is served over HTTPS, on paperbase.me or on the merchant’s own address.

milestones.title: Still shipping
milestones.text: Five repositories, with new releases most weeks.
